name: ai.limitguard.api/trust-intelligence
title: LimitGuard Trust Intelligence
description: Entity verification, sanctions screening, and trust scoring for AI agents via x402 micropayments.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer lg_live_... -- the full header value, 'Bearer ' included. Free key: POST https://api.limitguard.ai/v1/keys/create with an email.

tools.name: check_entity
tools.description: Full trust intelligence check on a business entity. Returns trust score (0-100), risk level, and recommendation.

entity_name.description: Full legal name of the entity

tools.name: verify_wallet
tools.description: Screen a wallet: OFAC SDN address match, on-chain signals (contract check, native and USDC balance, transaction count, first seen on Base) and named risk rules with up to 3 advice items. On Base, also reports any ERC-8004 agent the wallet owns and its open on-chain reputation as descriptive signals, never scored. Free ($0). Supports EVM and Solana addresses.

chain_id.description: CAIP-2 chain ID (default: eip155:8453 for Base); base, eth, solana, btc also accepted

tools.name: get_risk_score
tools.description: Quick risk assessment without full trust check. Focuses on risk signals only.

entity_name.description: Full legal name of the entity
